_readme: Example .claude/settings.json fragment wiring the journal guard.
Copy the PreToolUse block into the workspace's .claude/settings.json.
Editing hook wiring is an OPERATOR-APPROVED change (autonomy class C):
an agent proposes this via a Decision Packet in 50_registers/decision-queue.md;
a human applies it and records the approval in 80_governance/approvals/.
The shim is the only vendor-aware file; policy lives in tools/journal_guard.py.
Exit 2 from the shim denies the tool call; any other exit lets it through.
